raw_response:
I am too old to carry heavy bags of chemical fertilizer, and the cooperative gives priority to those growing teff and maize anyway. I will put cow dung around the trees like I always do, and my children will help me with the weeding and harvesting. I cannot afford to buy medicine for the plants or pay for water, so I leave that to God and the rains.
